gaps.issue: The interior-edge case is dismissed as “the usual one-dimensional convex regularization.” The proof neither derives ordinary convexity from CLD-plurisubharmonicity there nor constructs the decreasing sequence on one fixed neighborhood required by the strengthened conclusion.

gaps.location: pi_fa5c5878187fdb2ee1a7f1b5, proof of the second assertion, paragraph beginning “We first record two conditions”
gaps.issue: The claim that branchwise convexity together with the junction Jensen inequalities is a local property is not proved. Since a Jensen inequality couples points on different branches, this locality is nontrivial and is essential for applying the minimal-sheaf/transfinite definition to all CLD-psh functions.

repair_hints: [pi_fa5c5878187fdb2ee1a7f1b5] Supply the interior-edge regularization explicitly, including a fixed smaller interval and the uniform-to-monotone conversion. Also prove locality of the junction condition—for example, scale an admissible tuple into a common vertex neighborhood and use branchwise convexity to propagate the resulting Jensen inequality back to the original tuple—before invoking CLD minimality.
